name: Hack4SafeFood, certificate of participation
detail: Participation certificate for a hackathon on innovating food safety in Nepal, held to commemorate World Food Safety Day under the theme "Food Safety: Science in Action".
imageAlt: Hack4SafeFood certificate of participation naming Nishchal Panta, issued by DFTQC with Vertex Sustainability, for the hackathon held 2 to 6 June 2025.
